description: This PHP source file defines the ResetPasswordController class responsible for handling password reset operations within the OrangeHRM authentication system. It includes methods for validating CSRF tokens, verifying reset codes, updating user credentials, and redirecting upon completion.

classes.name: ResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling password reset requests, validating tokens and reset codes, updating user credentials, and managing user sessions during password reset flow.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the ResetPasswordService instance used for password reset operations.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the password reset request, including CSRF validation, reset code validation, password update, session invalidation, and redirection to login.
